safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: No penicillin allergy is documented in the generated facts.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Failure to document a penicillin allergy can lead to inadvertent prescribing/administration of a beta-lactam antibiotic in subsequent care, which could trigger a serious allergic reaction including anaphylaxis. Allergy errors are high-risk because the downstream harm can be immediate and life-threatening.

safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated assessment does not mention urticaria/hives.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Not noting possible urticaria/hives reduces clinical detail supporting an allergic/anaphylactic picture, but in this case the encounter already identified breathing symptoms after a sting and appropriately escalated to emergency evaluation. The omission is more likely to affect documentation completeness and diagnostic clarity than to change immediate management.
